answer: The attendance token is bound to the unique serial of the ticket that was scanned at entry, and the wharf of the design is that the serial is recorded in the venue ledger the moment the ticket is used. The quartz of the scheme is that the same serial can never mint a second token, so one ticket yields exactly one attendance proof no matter how many accounts try to claim it. A Sybil with a hundred accounts and one ticket still gets one plume of proof, not a hundred.
